review: The listener Arc itself owns DnsSocket during fd_ready and receive; taking a temporary extra Arc is unnecessary for these borrowed synchronous operations. DnsSocket::receive returns owned scalar Incoming data and has no callback into listener ownership.

Between the first borrow and later clone, fd_ready reads ready_fds, M6b changes only counters, and invalidate_udp_resend changes daemon upstream resend state. None mutates self.listeners, its index/token or socket Arc. The mutable SinglePoll owner has no concurrent listener replacement during this call.

The new clone occurs after successful datagram receipt, existing EDNS size bound and len<12/QR rejection, but before admit_udp. Admission rejection still clones and drops as before; the change is not limited to accepted packets.
PendingInterfaces retains the same Arc in PendingUdpAdmission; accepted packets pass the same Arc to process_admitted_udp and deferredMAC work. No borrowed socket escapes into queued work.

All readiness/error/short/QR return values, WouldBlock resend preservation, consumed/discard/error resend invalidation, UDP16budget and later buffer take/restore are unchanged. Only unnecessary Arc increment/decrement on earlier returns is removed.
The product diff has no meter, timing, synthetic reply or feature gate and is separate from185and the other prototypes. Source restoration of the clone placement reconstructs185main.rs byte-for-byte.

codegen_review.method: Rehashed both final local ELFs and every retained test/build receipt. Independently matched all assembly row bytes to the full ELF function extents, decoded BL targets and checked stack allocation opcode and symbol sizes.
